t: An open-source smartwatch and devkit you can rebuild and reprogram from scratch.
steps: Buy the ZSWatch Development Kit from Elecrow. It was listed at about 119 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable, plus a J-Link or a Nordic DK board to use as a debugger.
Install VS Code and the nRF Connect SDK with the setup guide.
Install nRF Util and the SEGGER J-Link tools.
Clone the ZSWatch firmware repo and build it for the WatchDK.
Flash the firmware and check the clock face on the screen.
Pair it with Gadgetbridge or the ZSWatch phone app.
Read the quick start known issues list before you change hardware jumpers.
